name: Colton Dunn
bio: Colton Dunn is an American comedian, actor, writer, and producer. He portrayed Garrett on the NBC workplace comedy Superstore (2015–2021) and worked on Comedy Central sketch comedy series Key & Peele (2013–2015), where he served as writer, producer, and an occasional performer throughout its five-season run. Dunn also played Herman in Lazer Team (2015) and its sequel Lazer Team 2 (2017).
